notes.text: Static finding at d4a2c8d: src/server/test-job-manager.ts enqueue copies input.worktree.head/branch/dirty; start only updates phase/timestamps before spawning run.cwd. A queue/source-change reproduction remains required by this item.

problem: TestRun stores HEAD, branch, and dirty state at enqueue time, then starts later from a mutable working directory without rechecking those fields. A passed run can therefore appear to validate an earlier commit that was never executed.

risk.rollback: Retain newly recorded source evidence and keep legacy/unknown provenance explicit when reverting presentation or scheduling changes. Do not destructively down-migrate run history or turn uncertain results into qualified passes.

scope: Record distinct enqueue and execution source state, including HEAD and dirty-state evidence. Revalidate the Git-discovered worktree immediately before starting.
Detect source changes while a run waits or executes. Choose and document a conservative stale/changed result that never silently certifies the requested revision.

Expose source uncertainty compactly in HTTP, MCP, and the dashboard. A clean Git index or a dirty boolean alone is not proof of immutable contents; do not promise full reproducibility or add worktree creation to this fix.
source: Repository assessment and owner direction on 2026-09-05
title: Report the source state actually used by queued verification
validation: Block the queue, enqueue revision A, change the worktree to B, then release the queue. Verify the record cannot claim an unqualified pass for A.
Change tracked or relevant untracked inputs without changing HEAD and verify the recorded uncertainty; cover removed/prunable worktrees before launch.
Verify unchanged source keeps the normal fast path and existing runs migrate without inventing execution-time metadata.
value: Agents can reuse verification evidence without rerunning tests merely to discover which code was checked.
